::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 12th 1881  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Dear [Miss Birley](people/person_153.qmd)

Many thanks for your two pretty books, I was a little startled at the [???] with which they afflicted you in ‘Yes and no’- but I hope that gentleman’s white lion[?] explains it sufficiently to be a fatherly embrace

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Perhaps Caroline Birley, whose story *A Heap of Stones* (London: SPCK 1881) had been published in *MP* (December 1880), 158-184, and who was also the author of *We are Seven: A Tale for Children*, with illustrations by T. Pym (London: Wells, Gardner 1880).   CMY seems to have been concerned about an illustration.
